narrative.title: The License Plate Trimmer
narrative.scenario: A DMV system shrinks oversized license plate codes by deleting exactly k digits so the remaining number reads as small as possible. A greedy pass retires any digit that is taller than the digit arriving right after it — each removal buys the biggest possible drop in value — and leftover deletions trim from the tail.
narrative.inputFormat: A string num of digits and an integer k, the count of deletions.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the smallest possible number as a string, with leading zeros stripped; the empty result prints as "0".
constraints: num consists of digits only and has no leading zeros (except the single digit "0")

testCases.explanation: Deleting 4, 3, and the second 2 leaves 1219, the smallest reachable value.
Removing the 1 leaves 0200; stripping the leading zero prints 200.
